title: Team Builder & Scoreboard
description: Make teams for a spontaneous activity and keep score: +1 / +2 / -1 per team. Tap a team's name to see who is in it. Add a note at the end saying what the points were for.

title: Tag-Team Talk
description: Relay talk at M.1, M.2 and M.3: one team at the front takes turns on a topic, TAG! at each chime. 100 topics per level, each with 3 hints, a Pick a team spinner, huddle and turn timer, speaking-order lane with your teams, +3 Win / +1 Challenge scoring.

title: Tag-Team Debate
description: FOR vs AGAINST team debate at M.1, M.2 and M.3: speakers take turns, answer the last point, then add a new one. Motion spinner, huddle and turn timer, speaking-order lane, +3 Win / +1 Challenge scoring.

title: Word Rush
description: Teams write as many words as they can for a prompt before the timer ends. Bonus cards change the scoring each round. Prompts for M.1, M.2 and M.3.

title: Think Tank Showdown
description: Critical-thinking game show: Riddle Rush, Rebus Round, Logic Puzzles, Final Wager (bet any points or ALL IN). M.3 adds red herrings. Questions for M.1, M.2 and M.3.

title: Talk Timer
description: Big classroom timer. Presets with one or more phases (for example 1:00 talk + 0:10 change over), a chime at zero. Edit your own presets.

title: Name Picker
description: A tool: picks a random present student. Nobody is picked twice until everyone has had a turn (remembered for the day). Points only if you turn them on.

title: Battle of Wits
description: Rounds of 5 questions: teams write each answer on one board while the timer runs (the next question comes by itself). Then the class checks the answers together, hidden bonuses are revealed, and each team adds up its points.

title: Battle of Readers
description: Each round: read a short story together, then 5 questions (true or false, short answers, find the mistake) written on one board per team. Then the class checks the answers, hidden bonuses are revealed, and each team adds up its points.

title: Battle of Writers
description: Rounds of 5 writing tasks on one board per team: put the words in order, build a sentence, fix the mistake, punctuate it, join two sentences, describe it. Then the class checks the answers, hidden bonuses are revealed, and each team adds up its points.

title: Quiz Grand Prix
description: A racing-themed quiz: every team drives its own vehicle round a 60-square track. Easy, regular, hard and impossible questions: harder ones roll 2 dice; a wrong answer rolls the back die. Chance cards, secret squares, exact roll to finish. Its own questions for M.1, M.2 and M.3 (plus your Questions tab or a unit).

title: North Pole Grand Prix
description: The North Pole version of Quiz Grand Prix: every team rides its own sleigh, sled or snowmobile, with Christmas pop-ups and cards, and a Christmas question bank: 100 general-knowledge questions (multiple choice and spoken) for every level. 🎄 squares draw a Challenge card; after a wrong answer a team can do a Forfeit and stay put instead of rolling back.

title: Quiz Island
description: One team at a time answers a quiz question and claims an island: harder questions are worth more. Hidden volcanoes, pirates and treasure chests, steals, power-ups, an optional random-student spinner and an all-in Final Wager. Use Race Board's questions, Quiz Battle's sets or a unit.

title: Board Race
description: A task appears (verb forms, a category, idioms). Teams line up at the whiteboard: one student writes one answer, then passes the pen to the next. You tap points per team.

title: Hot Seat Vocab
description: One student per team faces away from the board. Teammates describe the word without saying it. 60-second rounds, Got it (+1) or Skip. M.3 uses Person / Place / Thing / Idea.

title: Secret Message
description: Whisper down the line for two teams. The first student of each line sees a secret sentence, whispers it along, and the last student says it the other way: direct becomes reported and the reverse, for statements and questions. +1 for each correct team. M.1, M.2 and M.3.

title: 20 Questions
description: You think of a person, place, thing or idea; the class shows only the category. The whole class or two teams ask yes/no questions, with a countdown of questions left. The winner gets a point for each question left.

title: Class Order
description: A tool: go down the class list (by number or in a random order). Shows who is now and who is on deck; absent students keep their place. Remembers where you stopped for next lesson.

title: Dice & Spinner
description: Roll 1-3 dice, or spin a wheel with your own options (numbers, teams, topics, rewards). Don't-repeat option.

title: Noise Light
description: A full-screen traffic light for noise: tap green / yellow / red, or let the microphone measure how loud the class is.

title: Would You Rather?
description: Silly Would You Rather choices for the whole class, no teams and no points. Show the prompt, spin to pick a student, and they say their choice and why. M.1, M.2 and M.3 sets.

title: One-Word Story
description: A writing relay for teams. Each round one student per team runs to the board and has 5 seconds to write ONE word, building the team's story from an opener. The class reads the stories, you pick the best (+3). M.1, M.2 and M.3.

title: Scattergories
description: A letter and five categories (Animals, Food, Jobs...). Teams write a word for each before the timer ends. Words no other team has score extra.

title: Point 1-4
description: Four teams defend a medieval base (HQ, Depot, two Towers) and bomb each other. Answer questions to win bombs, repairs or gold; shop, fire, form alliances. Last base standing wins. Made with Job.

title: Gossip Circle
description: A tool: makes groups of 3 for the Gossip Circle (ask, report, check). Every round is new groups: nobody sits together twice until it can't be avoided. Teacher can join. No points.
